entries.text:
Today's session — Full Body Strength A (strength):
• 3 × 10 Goblet squat
• 3 × 8 Dumbbell bench press
• 3 × 8 One-arm dumbbell row

Today's Full Body Strength A is a balanced trio: 3 sets of 10 goblet squats, 3 sets of 8 dumbbell bench presses, and 3 sets of 8 one-arm dumbbell rows. That's a solid push-pull-squat combo—show up and give it your best. You've got the strength for this—let's make it count.
